message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover. At the top, red serif letters spell "TEMPO." Above this, black text reads "MAIN PROYEK DI KEMENTERIAN DESA." A smaller logo on the left contains the years "1971-2016" and four colored shapes. A date, "21-27 MARET 2016," appears on the right.

The central image is a light-colored map with a green square in the middle, crisscrossed by white roads and blue water lines. A long black horizontal bar with rounded ends is positioned in the center, containing the white text "DIKEPUNG UBER" and a right-pointing arrow in a circle. On its left side, a circle says "HLM 80."

Numerous gray car icons are scattered across the map. Many are clustered at the bottom, surrounding a single blue car icon with a yellow light on top. Some cars are oriented vertically, others horizontally or diagonally. At the bottom, two circular buttons are connected by a gray line: the left button shows a black car silhouette, and the right button shows a blue car silhouette. A barcode and price information are in the bottom-right corner.
